title: 2027 Corporate Affairs Development Program Intern (Undergraduate)
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Corporate Affairs Overview
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for AbbVie Interns.
Corporate Affairs advances AbbVie’s business priorities and reputation by connecting the company with the people and communities we serve. Our teams work across corporate marketing, communications, public affairs, corporate responsibility and philanthropy to build understanding, strengthen relationships and help AbbVie navigate a changing external environment.
Assignments may include opportunities across Corporate Marketing, Global Commercial Communications, Corporate Communications, and Corporate Responsibility & Global Philanthropy. Specific experiences will vary based on business priorities and may include:
Content strategy, development and publishing across AbbVie channels
Corporate, executive and employee communications
Brand, therapeutic area and disease-awareness communications
Media relations, storytelling and external engagement
Social and digital communications, including performance measurement
Corporate responsibility, philanthropy and community-impact initiatives
Key responsibilities include:
Support project teams in planning and executing Corporate Affairs initiatives and programs.
Conduct research and gather information to support communications, stakeholder engagement and business priorities.
Develop presentations, reports, content, and other materials for internal and external audiences.
Analyze information and summarize insights, trends and recommendations for team members and leaders.
Collaborate with colleagues across Corporate Affairs and other functions to support cross-functional projects.
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in university, pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in public relations, communications, integrated marketing, journalism or other related field
Must be enrolled in university for at least one semester following the internship
Expected graduation date between December 2027 – June 2028

Demonstrated leadership skills (i.e. extracurricular activities, projects or internships)

title: Associate Director, Field Planning, Oncology Franchise E & V
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Associate Director, Field Planning, Oncology is responsible for leading call planning and targeting efforts, directing sales force structure and sizing initiatives, managing territory alignments, as well as executing analyses that enable the Oncology demand generating and facilitating teams to be more effective and efficient.  The individual will partner with peer analytic and technology functions as well as the Oncology commercial teams to ensure that field teams are deployed and supported in line with the respective brands’ strategy.
Function Responsibilities Include:
Strategic Planning : Play a key role in partnering with commercial leadership to proactively align on long range strategic plans for the Oncology brands, identifying and responding to business needs as they arise.  Infuse a customer-focused mindset to deliver business solutions to ensure field deployment efforts are aligned with, and in support of, strategic imperatives.
Targeting : Partner with Marketing, Sales, Field Planning & Analytics Team (FPAT), and Marketing Analytics & Business Insights (MABI) leadership to continually refine and improve Account and HCP targeting approaches based on the needs of the business and the dynamics of the market, thus ensuring that field resourcing efforts are planned and deployed optimally.
Call Planning : Lead the development of cycle-based call panels that reflect marketing and sales objectives for the Oncology teams. Ensure that the process is performed in alignment and cooperation with FPAT and MABI partners.
Sales Force Sizing and Alignment Support : Manage the cycle-based adjustments to field alignments that ensure relevance with the evolving market and an ongoing workload balance across the country. Lead the sizing and/or re-sizing efforts required when major changes within the Oncology franchises dictate footprint optimization.
Ad-hoc Analytics : Work with internal FPAT members as well as our Marketing, Sales, and MABI partners to generate timely insights specific to trends or events impacting the brands or the sales teams.  Partner with the Field Tools group to transform ad-hoc analyses into standardized reporting if/when ongoing production is required.
Operational Excellence : Represent subject matter expertise for each of these responsibilities and understand the cross-functional dependencies that they place on other groups and processes to ensure that the totality of cycle planning runs smoothly and accurately. Proactively recommend improvements to business rules and processes to enhance functional relevance and/or reduce cycle time.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities:
Structure : Manage 1 direct report in support of all functional responsibilities for the Oncology franchises. Will need to expertly balance leading vs doing based on the needs of the team as well as the needs of the franchises.
Coach : Convey subject matter expertise, experiential learnings, and feedback to your direct report(s) to give them the tools and confidence to think at an enterprise level while executing at a functional level.
Support : Ensure the team is adequately resourced for current, cyclical, and future objectives. Understand their needs and provide leadership in the manner that best fits the situation and their personality, whether it be via rolling up your sleeves to execute tasks, managing the expectations of the stakeholder, prioritizing objectives, or providing detailed guidance.
Development : Work with your team to understand where they are in their development and understand where they strive to be in their respective futures and then set actionable goals for the short term (annual performance process) and the long term (individual development plan). Provide continuous and constant feedback in line with these goals and identify ways to improve areas of opportunity and capitalize on areas of strength.
BA/BS degree required or equivalent experience, advanced degree preferred
8+ years of pharmaceutical/health care experience is a must
Prior sales planning experience with responsibilities aligned to this role is a must
Background
Strong leader who can motivate individuals towards a shared purpose.
Collaborates and influences without authority in a matrixed organization.
Excellent judgment and decision-making skills.
Can communicate insights and recommendations to Executive, Sales, and Brand Leadership.
Understanding of field sales activities, roles, and behaviors preferred.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.
Ability to clearly and confidently articulate complex and difficult concepts.
Ability to develop and deliver training and communications.
Excellent business acumen and an understanding of basic corporate finance and financial analysis concepts.
Experience working directly with pharmaceutical sales data sources.
Ability to thrive in a team and cross-functional environment.
Ability to develop and execute innovative, creative solutions.
Results-oriented with exceptional process, project, and resource management skills.
Consistent ability to meet and exceed agreed upon timelines.

The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​

You should have experience in uses of traditional and digital media channels, as you’re expected to conceive, plan and execute winning, innovative media solutions across various products consistent with each brand’s business strategies.
More specifically, you will be responsible for the development and execution of all media activities under your assigned brands/indications, identifying target audience and ideal channels to reach our targets. ​Duties include working with our media agency to identify and recommend media outlets that fit the target audience and key segments, implementing the schedule via the agencies, disseminating media flowcharts and placed buys, and manage media billing process.​ You will provide divisional POVs and white papers, make presentations to the Marketing teams as well as with cross functional teams.  Experience in Hematology Oncology is preferred; Multiple Myeloma experience a plus.

Ensures all media strategies ladder up to and deliver on the brand business goals and objectives.
Ensures media strategies are strong and push brands towards results.
Ensure each plan has innovation, test & learn components.
Push the envelope for ways to bring creativity and innovation to the media plans.
Works with the media agency to translate media strategies into tactics.
Media Buying and Buy Stewardship.
Ensures media agency teams come with great ideas, strong executions, efficiencies and effective measurement for assigned brands/indications.
Manages and implement approved media plan ensuring flawless execution and all deadlines are met.
Review vendor consideration set with the agencies.
Brand/Agency Management.
Develop and maintain effective day-to-day relationships with Marketing teams and our agency of record.
Thorough understanding of brands’/indications' business and important facets.
Coach, mentor, motivate agency personnel.
Review all brand sharing documents and ensure accuracy.
Media Administration.
Ensure internal and Agency AOR teams are adhering to planning process, policies & procedures for assigned accounts.
Ensure all Media budgets are met and constantly monitored.
Ensures all monthly/quarterly reporting is received and shared internally in a timely fashion.
Participating in media agency feedback surveys as well as performance review meetings.
Industry Knowledge.
Thorough understanding of the changing Hematology-Oncology landscape, paid media industry trends, audience trends, promotional resources, and the competitive landscape.
Attend industry trade shows to keep current on marketplace knowledge.

Tracking/monitoring media activity, including competitive analysis.
Disseminate competitive reporting to brand teams and data analytics groups.
Collaborate with Public Affairs and other advocacy groups.

The focus will be on direct selling of products (physician dispensed skincare and skin resurfacing system) and executing pull through programs/events to patients. This is accomplished by utilizing and managing key resources and contributing with high performance selling teams to maximize coverage to targeted customers. The SAM provides technical product and procedure expertise, as well as, competitive product differentiation. Assigned sales goals are obtained through creative, consultative selling and implementation of the U.S. Sales/Marketing plan.
Responsibilities
The SAM leverages Allergan Medical’s resources to enhance adoption of the SKM Portfolio which includes 1) non-surgical, non-invasive skin resurfacing equipment, 2) topical skincare consumables designed for the resurfacing device and 3) SkinMedica product portfolio. Must collaborate with Facial Aesthetics, Plastic Surgery, Coolsculpting, APC’s, Marketing, and other Allergan sales forces. Complies with required reports, requests, and compliance policies.
Effectively manages field assets and resources to include, but not limited to, expense management, computer, and other allocated equipment.
SALES RESULTS: Consistently achieves sales quota for skin care, consumables, and equipment. Proficient in sales execution component of marketing plans to include device placement and pull through product promotions (device, consumables and SkinMedica portfolio). Creates call plans across product portfolio. Demonstrates adaptability with multiple initiatives.
Demonstrates effective selling skills (demonstrate Dermalinfusion Treatments, educate customers on proper techniques for Dermalinfusion Treatments, consultative sales approach to the customers' business, pre-call plans, Intro/credentialing, assessment of customer needs, handling objections, presentation delivery with visuals, closing, follow-up, etc.). Builds loyal relationships; high level customer interaction.
Calls on and effectively manages time with new and existing customers to educate on new and current products. Works with customers toward business development by assessing and product needs, placing account orders, merchandising office, and supporting events for pull-through.
Manages initiative execution across the portfolio balancing the device sale to drive skin care and consumable business. Demonstrates ability to assess territory metrics to develop and implement territory business plans; computer proficiency (excel, internet, PowerPoint); use of sales reporting tools; responds timely to corporate requests; balances work load demonstrating good organizational skills, and optimizes corporate resource and budget allocation. Provides product samples as necessary.
Educates customers on device and product features and benefits through individual and group presentations/trainings. Conveys consistent differentiating messaging across portfolio; technical fluency across Allergan and competitive product portfolio. Demonstrates an expertise in discussing support studies/material, proficient with knowledge of the aesthetic market. Portrays strong business acumen.
Demonstrates the ability to execute marketing plans across product portfolio. Understands sales execution role within the marketing plan. Ability to understand marketing team's role and provide appropriate feedback to plan implementation. Ability to articulate strategy to RM and team members. Ability to understand how individual tactics support the overall strategic direction. Understands and adheres to compliance and travel/expense policies.
Exemplifies integrity, flexibility, and adaptability. Ability to understand multiple perspectives of decisions beyond one territory. Is self-aware of interaction with customers, peers, etc. Demonstrates the ability to make sound decisions and uses good judgment. Is reliable and has a willingness to improve. Portrays a positive and productive attitude in working with counterparts toward collaboration supporting the portfolio of business.
Bachelor's degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Minimum of 3+ years of sales experience required with business to business to consumer (B2B2C) sales experience preferred.
Aesthetics sales background or related experience with a skin care company highly desirable

Experience with fulfillment services, warehouse operations, warehouse design, and system configuration support

Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated ability to use data-driven decision making to prioritize operational issues, support root cause analysis, and drive continuous improvement across distribution execution.

title: Business Process Improvement Manager
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.
The Difference You Will Make:
The Business Process Manager will be a senior individual contributor within the Service Optimization team, part of the Community Service Organization. This role advances the team's process engineering discipline by designing systems where problems do not occur, rather than only improving processes that already exist. The Business Process Manager delivers through deep individual expertise: applying systems thinking, engineering processes for AI-readiness and automation by default, and building AI prototypes to test and validate new process designs before full implementation. This is a role for a senior level practitioner who operates at the intersection of process engineering, systems design, and applied AI.
A Typical Day:
Develop business strategies within Service Optimization and Community Support across people, process, and technology.
Lead the operationalization of strategies across Community Support and other cross functional teams such as Policy, Finance, and Product.
Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.
Apply and coach others to apply a systems thinking lens to every problem: map full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.
Design processes for AI-readiness and automation by default, engineering every future state around three standards: does it reduce agent and customer burden, is it measurable from day one, and can it be automated or self-correcting over time.
Build AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.
Use process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.
Develop and continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.
Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.
Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.
Build and scale process engineering competency, systems thinking, and AI-ready design, contributing to capability building across the team.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.
Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.

Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of post-graduate experience in operations, process management, or process improvement, with at least 7 years in a customer support operations environment (preferred).

Demonstrated ability to build AI prototypes and proof-of-concept workflow automations: practical experience using AI tools, no-code or low-code platforms, or scripting to test and validate process designs before full implementation.
Demonstrated mastery to design processes for AI-readiness and automation, engineering systems that evolve with AI capabilities rather than simply optimizing existing workflows.
Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.
Advanced statistical and data-driven analytical skills, including statistical process control methods, regression analysis, and measurement system analysis.
Experience using process simulation tools to model process behavior, test design assumptions, and predict outcomes under varying conditions prior to implementation.
Demonstrated experience driving organizational change, including stakeholder alignment, communication planning, and adoption measurement.
Proven ability to interact and communicate with people at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, in an open and transparent manner.
Proven ability to work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to influence, structure arguments clearly, and drive alignment to measurable outcomes without formal authority.

title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, QC Pre-Construction, North America Quick Commerce
description:
The Quick Commerce (QC) Pre-Construction team is looking for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III (TIPM III) to own the pre-construction strategy, technical design standards, site feasibility evaluation, and international design benchmarking for QC’s rapidly scaling North America network.
QC deploys multiple physical infrastructure formats, including Stand Alone and Co-Located sites, where pre-construction requirements vary by site type, existing building conditions, infrastructure capacity, permitting jurisdiction, and deployment scenario.
This role operates at the intersection of technical design and site readiness, defining how prospective QC sites are evaluated for infrastructure feasibility, how design packages produced by Architects of Record (AORs) and Engineers of Record (EORs) are reviewed for constructability and specification compliance, and how international quick commerce design approaches are benchmarked and adapted to improve QC’s North America standards.
The TIPM III will develop and maintain site evaluation criteria, technical design review standards, AOR/EOR performance frameworks, cost estimating methodologies, permitting strategies, and change-management mechanisms that govern QC pre-construction delivery. You will use technical domain knowledge to assess site feasibility, evaluate AOR/EOR design deliverables, identify design and permitting risks, challenge cost and schedule assumptions, benchmark technical solutions against international quick commerce operators, and provide feedback to Design Engineering, Real Estate, and Construction teams for specification and process improvement.
This role goes beyond reviewing a completed design package. You will define and continuously improve the pre-construction process itself into scalable standards that improve speed, design quality, cost predictability, and constructability across the QC portfolio.
Key job responsibilities
• Own and continuously improve QC pre-construction technical design and site evaluation standards across formats.
• Develop site feasibility criteria, technical design review checklists, cost estimating frameworks, and due diligence standards.
• Define new pre-construction processes where established evaluation methods, design review workflows, or permitting strategies do not yet exist.
• Evaluate prospective sites for infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, constructability, permitting complexity, cost, and operational requirements to inform site selection decisions.
• Lead technical review of AOR and EOR design deliverables, evaluating design packages for constructability, specification compliance, infrastructure integration risks, code compliance, and alignment with QC deployment standards before construction handoff.
• Benchmark QC technical design standards against international quick commerce operators, identifying design innovations, infrastructure approaches, and deployment methodologies that can be adapted to improve QC’s North America standards.
• Partner with Design Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, and external AOR/EOR partners to resolve complex pre-construction issues and align site evaluation criteria.
• Root-cause recurring pre-construction issues and translate findings into upstream improvements to site selection criteria, design specifications, AOR/EOR scopes, cost models, and permitting processes.
• Establish change-management mechanisms ensuring design learnings, cost data, jurisdictional findings, and international benchmarking insights are consistently incorporated into future site evaluations and design standards.
• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex pre-construction issues, determining whether gaps stem from site conditions, AOR/EOR design quality, cost assumptions, permitting, or evaluation methodology.
A day in the life
You start by reviewing a batch of prospective sites, assessing infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, permitting jurisdiction complexity, and technical constraints to inform site selection and determine fit for QC deployment. Mid-morning, you lead a design review session on an AOR’s 90% construction document set, flagging a refrigeration layout concern and a fire protection code question that need resolution before permit submission. After lunch, compare QC’s cold-chain infrastructure approach against a leading international quick commerce operator’s design, identifying an equipment standardization opportunity worth exploring. You then join a call with a municipality and EDP partners to resolve an open plan review comment that is holding up a permit timeline. Before end of day, you document lessons from a recently permitted site and update the EOR scope of work template so the next design cycle captures requirements that were missed in this round. Your work turns site evaluation, design review, and international benchmarking learnings into repeatable improvements for future QC deployments.
About the team
The QC Pre-Construction team evaluates and prepares multiple site formats across varying building conditions, jurisdictions, and infrastructure configurations supporting Amazon’s Quick Commerce across North America. TIPMs work alongside Pre-Construction Managers, Construction, Design Engineering, Real Estate, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, EDP, and external AOR/EOR partners to develop scalable pre-construction solutions. While Pre-Construction Managers lead day-to-day site evaluation and project setup activities, TIPMs define and improve the technical standards that guide how sites are assessed and how design partners deliver.

- Experience managing AOR, EOR, or A&E consultant relationships, including scopes of work, design deliverable reviews, performance management, and technical issue resolution.

title: Wireless MAC Design Verification Engineer
description:

In this highly visible role, you will be at the center of a silicon design group with a critical impact on delivering world-class silicon to empower wireless products for hundreds of millions of customers. As a Wireless Design Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for pre-silicon RTL verification of wireless MAC and its interfaces with the rest of the wireless SoC. Verification experience of wireless/wired communication block/subsystem.

title: Wireless SOC Design Verification Engineer

Over time, you’ll build depth in the IPs you know best and breadth across others, from block-level verification up toward subsystem and SOC integration.
You’ll own verification for your scope — with a mentor’s guidance as you build toward full ownership — on a chip that ships in every new iPhone, starting with a block or feature sized to where you are and expanding from there. You’ll work across the Power Management Unit, the CPU subsystem, on-chip debug infrastructure, PCIe, bus fabric, boot and secure-boot sequencing, and peripherals like SPI and UART — primarily through simulation, with exposure to formal verification as you grow. Low-power is part of the picture too: you’ll get hands-on with power intent verification using UPF within your scope. Strong academic record (GPA).
Proficiency in SystemVerilog.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Exposure to PCIe, Bus Fabric, NOC, AHB, AXI-based bus architectures in a UVM environment.
Experience verifying IP or top-level integration for a WiFi or Bluetooth SOC.
Experience with Formal Verification.
In-depth knowledge and experience working with low power design, UPF integration, boot-up, power-cycling, HW/FW interaction verification.

title: Global Cybersecurity Senior Manager – Architecture

description:
SENIOR ASSOCIATE, PRIVATE EQUITY DATA PRODUCTS

With approximately $225 billion of assets under management, Bain Capital is one of the world’s leading private investment firms. Over four decades we have strategically grown our platform to focus on Private Equity, Growth & Venture, Capital Solutions, Credit, and Real Assets. ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a senior, hands-on Senior Associate to join our Data Products team. You will own the Private Equity data products in Snowflake, from the platform foundations to business-critical data processes. You will be a technical expert on a small product team, and you will report to the Director of Data Products.
The ideal candidate is an experienced technologist with strong platform instincts. You know Snowflake deeply. You think in systems and abstractions, not one-off pipelines. You work AI-first: you write clear specifications, use AI coding agents to build, and validate that the result meets the specification. You treat infrastructure, permissions, and governance as code.
You will partner directly with leaders in Private Equity Finance, Investment Operations, and Data Governance. The foundations you build, including data certification, lineage, data quality, and platform automation, will become the pattern for other data domains across the firm.
RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE
Own ingestion and data modeling for Private Equity source systems, including fund accounting, valuation, portfolio monitoring, and HR and time data.
Deliver changes from specification to production quickly, using AI coding agents, and review and validate their output.
Build data certification, owner sign-off, definitions, lineage, and data quality checks into the codebase, in partnership with the VP of Data Governance.

Configure Snowflake for the domain, including role-based access design, warehouse and cost management, data sharing, and multi-account setup.
Manage infrastructure, permissions, and governance metadata as code, using Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and controlled promotion between environments.
Translate complex business processes into clear data models and system designs, and shape the capability roadmap with the product manager.
Set technical standards, review designs and code, and mentor contractor and offshore engineers. Work closely with Data Engineering, Information Security, and Cloud Operations.

Deep Snowflake experience: role-based access control, cost management, data sharing, and multi-account architecture. SnowPro Core or Advanced certification is a plus.
AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) as your primary way of working, including MCP and reusable skills.

Production-grade Python.
Infrastructure and data as code: Terraform (including the Snowflake provider), GitHub Actions, and CI/CD for data. Experience with governance-as-code, policy-as-code, or data contracts is a plus.

Working knowledge of dbt.

AWS services such as S3, serverless products, and ECR, and monitoring tools such as Datadog or CloudWatch.
Experience with private markets or fund accounting data (e.g., Investran) is a plus.
QUALIFICATIONS
BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
7+ years of professional data platform, data engineering, or software engineering experience.
Strong foundation in software design and architectural patterns.
Ability to explain technical choices clearly to finance and operations stakeholders.
Proven ability to turn business requirements into clear specifications and scalable designs.
Ownership mindset, from concept to production and ongoing operation.
Experience mentoring others and raising a team's technical standards.

At Bain Capital, you will join a small, AI-native team that partners directly with Private Equity leadership. You will build data foundations that the whole firm will reuse, in a collaborative environment that values innovation and excellence.

title: Global Supply Manager - Services
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base is looking for a Global Supply Manager to own strategy and procurement for the services and partners that keep Base building, delivering, and scaling. The individual will be focused on facility services, HVAC and building maintenance, utilities, furniture, signage, office supplies, and food and beverage. Base is opening locations across the country, and today each site finds its own vendors from scratch. You'll replace that with nationwide agreements, a preferred vendor list, and a repeatable vendor playbook for every new site, using Base's combined volume to get better pricing and more consistent service.

While experience in facilities or procurement is valuable, we’re more interested in finding exceptional people who learn quickly, take ownership, and are excited to build. This is a chance to help build a procurement organization from the ground up, with meaningful ownership, direct work with business leaders, and hands-on experience in negotiation, commercial strategy, contract drafting, supplier management, cost optimization, and executive communication from day one.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead end-to-end sourcing for Base warehouses, including facility services, HVAC and building maintenance, utilities, furniture, signage, office supplies, and catered food.

 - Negotiate nationwide and regional agreements that use Base's total volume to lower cost and give every site consistent pricing, service levels, and terms.

 - Build and maintain a preferred vendor list and site playbook so the internal team can get core services in place at a new location quickly, without recreating the wheel each time.

 - Draft, review, redline, and negotiate contracts with service providers, and suppliers, including master service agreements, statements of work, pricing schedules, and service-level terms, writing clear language that conveys business intent and reduces risk.

 - Run RFPs and RFQs, benchmark pricing, and recommend the right commercial structure (e.g., national vs. regional coverage, fixed vs. usage-based pricing) based on business needs and risk.

 - Partner with Workplace Operations, Deployments, Real Estate & Construction, Finance, Legal, and site leaders to understand requirements and launch timelines, working toward practical, cost-effective solutions.

 - Run regular supplier scorecard reviews on cost, service quality, and responsiveness, and give suppliers clear feedback that drives improvement.

 - Travel periodically to Base sites to understand needs, meet suppliers, and support new site launches.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - High ownership and work ethic: you take responsibility for outcomes, follow through on commitments, and put in the effort to help build a world-class procurement organization.

 - Fast learner, comfortable with ambiguity: you quickly learn new categories, markets, and suppliers, and are resourceful enough to create clarity and next steps when no playbook exists.

 - Strong communicator: able to influence site leaders, operators, and suppliers without formal authority.

 - Sharp analytical and commercial instincts: strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with urgency.

 - Background in procurement, sourcing, facilities management, operations, finance, or consulting preferred. Experience with facility services or multi-site spend is a plus.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

Our strategic procurement team procures the goods and services Base runs on outside of the battery itself: software, site services, facilities, equipment, consumables, contractors, and the vendor relationships behind them. We're building the function from the ground up, setting up the contracts, vendor lists, and processes that let every team buy quickly without overpaying. As Base grows, the agreements this team puts in place decide how fast we grow and our spend and savings.

Every dollar we save goes back into the mission. Homeowners across the country rely on Base for whole-home backup and below-market electricity rates, while our aggregated storage supports grid stability at a moment when demand is accelerating from AI infrastructure, electrification, and extreme weather. You'll get real ownership, direct access to business leaders, and the chance to shape how a fast-growing energy company buys.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

As a Mobile Diesel Technician I, you'll take your skills on the road to perform licensed DOT inspections, preventative maintenance, diagnostics and repairs.
This is more than just a technician role with great pay and benefits – it's a chance to work independently and strengthen your skills with a company that invests in your success.  You also get to take home the assigned service vehicle!

*** If you have any questions or to connect with a recruiter while your application is being reviewed, please Text DFS3 to 317-597-8130 ***
What You'll Do
You'll work independently in the field, providing mobile service and maintenance support for light, medium, and heavy-duty vehicles.  You will:
Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light, medium and heavy-duty vehicles in a mobile/field environment.
Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Independently manage parts inventory and equipment provided on company-issued service truck and perform periodic reconciliation.
Maintain and operate company-issued service vehicle, conduct safety checks, and pre-/post-trip inspections of vehicle.
Work with and listen effectively to clients and customers to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations.
Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.
Use hand tools, precision instruments, as well as Diesel tools, welding equipment, lift and jacks.
Document according to company standards and upload pictures of work performed, parts used, and all findings observed on Repair Orders (“RO”) using company-issued iOS device and our proprietary TRAIT application.
Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in a timely fashion.
Work with a high degree of independence and manage own daily schedule.
Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.
Obtain parts from approved local and national vendors as necessary for the repairs to be performed.
Communicate with management and support team via email or phone to obtain approvals on repair estimates, retrieve purchase order numbers and/or discuss RO findings notes.
Perform all work in compliance with organizational safety, health and environmental policies, and federal regulations, to include OSHA, EPA, and DOT.
Maintain company issued service truck, conduct safety checks and daily pre/post trip inspections.

ASE T4 (Brakes) certification
ASE T8 (PMI) certification
SKILLS & ABILITIES
Understand the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.
Ability to lift, bend, climb, stand, and walk for long periods of time; ability to perform moderately heavy laboring work
Ability to exert oneself physically over long periods of time without tiring, which may include performing repetitive tasks.
Communicates information (for example, facts, ideas, or messages) in a succinct and organized manner.  Engages in effective two-way communication with individuals and groups.

title: Assistant Site Manager
description:
About the Team
DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality.
About the Role
In this role, you’ll work within a 5-15k sq ft distribution center, will assist in leading the local warehouse operating team, and in some locations, includes preparing food in a light-prep kitchen, and help the Site Manager ensure we maintain high quality for our customers.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead: You’ll demonstrate compassion and commitment to inclusivity as you lead a team of hourly Operations Associates and Shift Leads. You’ll hire, coach and develop high-performing team members, while building a safety-first culture where employees are excited to drive success, personally and for the team. You’ll serve as a leading change agent for your site, helping your team to navigate new initiatives and growth projects. You’ll tackle onsite escalations, including coordination with cross-functional partners.
Operate: With your thumb on the pulse of all outcomes for your team, you will be directly responsible for driving results in one or more specific focus areas or a specific shift for your site. To achieve your performance targets, you’ll drive success through effective scheduling and by executing inventory management processes and deploying best practices from across the network. You’ll engage cross-functional partners as needed for support.
Strategize: Within the focus area(s) assigned by your Site Manager, you’ll analyze data and make strategic recommendations and execute actions regarding resource allocation, workflow, warehouse organization and when to engage cross-functional partners. You may also lead some process improvement projects.
Delight: We are customer-obsessed. You’ll coach and empower your team to provide a highly quality customer experience with every order. Quality metrics such as order accuracy and fulfillment speed will be key measurements of success for your team. You’ll also work cross-functionally with central teams from our inventory to training teams to ensure your team has the tools and resources they’ll need to deliver.
We’re excited about you because…
You’re a proven leader. You have managed high-performance teams of 5+ employees with successful performance and employee development outcomes.
You relish ownership. You’re excited to have ownership in a new and rapidly growing business. No problem is too big or too small for you, and you’re ready to show up however needed for your team.
You solve problems from first principles.   You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
You’re unafraid of ambiguity.   Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments.
You’re analytical . You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver and you have experience using Excel or Google Sheets to analyze data, including using basic formulas and creating pivot tables.
You have 3+ years’ experience : In Operations, Warehouse Logistics, Customer Service, Retail Management, Fulfillment, or related field
You have 1+ years of experience managing a team
You have flexibility in your schedule. As the leader of the site, you will need to ensure your team and the site is fully supported, which will include regularly scheduled late-night and weekend hours.
Compensation
Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.
To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .
See below for paid time off details:
For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado. $56,200 — $82,700 USD About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Fortune Brands runs on Boomi. The platform carries 445 integrations and roughly 1.75 million transactions a day, spanning 11 brands and 35 business capabilities, and nearly every customer-facing system we operate connects through it. It runs around the clock.
As Senior Boomi Integration Developer, you are the United States-based technical lead for that estate. You own integration architecture, you design, build, test, deploy and support the integrations themselves, and you make the call when something breaks in production.

Select, evaluate, and qualify suppliers
Part qualification including pFMEAs, FAIRS, Cpk, and Control Plans
Supplier Corrective Action Request initiation, execution, and closure
Ensure compliance to quality management system and regulatory requirements by leading and mentoring auditors for QMS audits
Lead detailed projects of transfers of the supply of products and components
Create strategies to effectively optimize the supply base by leading efforts to optimize supply networks.

Drive changes to ISI specifications through influencing and educating resulting in changing specifications and drawings including driving the ECO process to implementation.

Prepare and deliver supplier communications as required by independently working with suppliers on scorecard creation of QBRs, Supplier Summits, etc.
Facilitate supplier contract development to execution and maintenance by negotiating contracts as necessary in collaboration with the contract team and Supply Chain Management.
Manage the ASL and Global Commodity Matrix
Work with suppliers and ISI engineering for the new product introduction to:
Create product supplier landscapes to determine launch readiness and report to management
Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability.
DFM by engaging suppliers early in development cycle to feedback manufacturability improvements in the designs prior to production
Influence and guide Engineering in choosing suppliers by determining selection criteria for preferred suppliers and leading the team effort to evaluate preferred suppliers.
Deliver the following Quality deliverables: pFMEA, Special Process Validations, FAI, and Cpk by leading, training and mentoring suppliers through the pFMEA development, judging process validation requirements and signing-off on protocols as ISI rep, judging process capability with supplier as well as judging FAI suitability.
Develop the supplier business continuity / disaster recovery plans by managing suppliers to create plans, judge plans for risks and negotiate with suppliers to reduce risks. Identify and investigate opportunities for cost reduction and/or quality improvement by judging opportunities and creating strategies to seize those opportunities, completes research and provides data-driven plans to management.
Review, analyze and close customer complaints, manufacturing variance requests, and first article inspections by judging risk analyses and justifications, determining corrective and preventive actions at suppliers, looks for opportunities with suppliers to eliminate recurrence.

BS degree in Engineering or equivalent, experience in machining commodity preferred
Minimum 10 years related experience in Supplier Engineering/Development/Quality or related field
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
Excellent Interpersonal skills and team building skills
A proven history of implementing Lean/6 Sigma/SPC Programs at suppliers
Excellent Project Management skills
Excellent analytical and problem solving skills along with good judgment
Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, cost and capacity (specialization can be in metal fabrication, plastics, electronics, and/or contract manufacturing)
Excellent knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485 (experience in auditing suppliers to these standards)
Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Access and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP
CAD experience with 3D modeling tools is a plus
Proven ability to motivate suppliers
Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus
Ability to read and interpret detailed mechanical drawings and communicate technical information
Ability to travel to suppliers on an as needed basis – domestic and international

description:

Primary Function of Position:
As an Electrical Engineer, you will work with a group of talented and dedicated people to improve and extend Intuitive robotic product lines. You will contribute broadly to the Future Forward group, with a focus on the development of innovative electronics at the heart of Intuitive systems.
As a member of the Future Forward engineering team, you will work cross-functionally and be involved in designing, implementing, and testing complex mixed-signal PCBAs and integrating them into complete surgical robot solutions and seeing these through human use and product release.
The successful candidate has familiarity with the design and integration of mixed-signal PCBAs, is comfortable troubleshooting at the board and system level and has previous exposure to the medical devices development processes.
Quick learning and a desire to understand requirements from a user and engineering’s perspective are essential to become a valuable system developer. An exceptional sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the ability to make work fun and interesting. Supporting you will be a development and management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.
Essential Job Duties
This position is involved in all aspects related to the electronic board design (PCBAs) for robotic surgical systems. The Electrical Engineer will:
Design or modify PCBAs, participating in electrical architecture definition, selecting components, designing schematics (OrCAD preferred), performing component placement, stack-up definition, and overseeing PCB layout.
Work with contract manufacturers (CM) to coordinate timely arrival of prototypes and production PCBAs.
Bring up and debug prototypes, work with embedded software teams to test various functions of the board.
Represent Electrical Engineering on cross-functional project teams for designing and developing next generation robotic surgery.
Adopt the best methods to meet product requirements and integrate them into effective designs.
Develop, implement, test and document solutions according to clinical, statutory, and environmental requirements.
Provide technical expertise to resolve challenging design, field and manufacturing issues.
Develop prototypes to aid actions for future product development.
Provide technical support to other stakeholders on electrical engineering concepts
Support the quality and regulatory process.
Ensure that medical device designs meet product quality and safety requirements, in compliance with design control processes defined in the Quality Management System.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience with mixed-signal PCB designs, embedded system design, and PCBA design for harsh environments.
Strong foundations on electrical engineering concepts: analog, digital, high-speed and signal integrity, MPSoCs, FPGAs, MCUs, DC/DC power converters.
Hardware development experience in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment, preferably in medical surgical or therapeutic products.
Familiarity in all phases of the product development lifecycle, including design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer to manufacturing.
Hands-on engineering skills and ability to work well in a team environment.
Understanding of component selection criteria, design for reliability and manufacturability.
Excellent communication skills (written and oral) across all levels and organizations.
Ability to collaborate closely with software and FPGA teams for architecture definition, processor/FPGA selection and interface definition.
Required Education and Training
Minimum Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or adjacent technical field with 4 years of experience, or Master's degree with 3 years of experience, or PhD degree with 2 years of experience.
4 years of focused and hands-on mixed-signal board-level design from architecture phase through production.

The Senior Mechanical Engineer for Instrument and Accessory Advanced Product Development will be a member of a small team responsible for exploring and developing early product concepts and technologies that will help feed the da Vinci product pipeline. The successful candidate will lead early assessment, design, development, and testing of novel concepts for instrument and accessory related products.
The candidate will help to identify and evaluate new technologies in light of customer and company needs, establish design requirements to meet customer needs, work with suppliers and other outside companies and consultants to realize viable technical solutions, and refine designs for transfer to the New Product Development organization for commercialization. Essential Job Duties
Work within cross-functional project teams to create, evaluate, and prove out new product architectures and refine them for hand off to new Product Development
Collaborate with subject matter experts to understand the clinical, usability, and other needs of users of da Vinci systems as they relate to surgical instruments and accessories.
Develop technical requirements for designs based on an understanding of customer needs, commercial objectives (e.g. cost of goods), regulatory requirements, and feasibility constraints .
Perform conceptual design, detailed design, analytical modeling, prototyping, data analysis, and troubleshooting of novel instruments and accessories for the da Vinci robotic surgical system .
Develop and perform early performance testing, with assistance from other functions as needed. Assist with evaluation of prototypes by supporting bench, ex-vivo, and in-vivo laboratory testing with clinical experts.
Develop and manage relationships with key partners .
Provide written protocols, reports, and presentations related to design activities on an ongoing basis .
Review mechanical engineering designs of other Intuitive engineers in both a formal and informal capacity .
Refine and document product designs as needed to support successful transfer into the new product development organization.
Other Functions
Assess technologies from outside entities for potential licensing and adaptation to the da Vinci product line
Identify, test, and report on new materials, manufacturing processes, and technologies that could benefit existing products or enable new product designs
Document, prepare and review patent submissions
Required Skills and Experience
Minimum five (5) years of experience taking products from concept to production (medical product experience preferred).
At least eight (8) years of experience with precision mechanical design.
Familiarity with all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer .
Understanding of mechatronics, robotics, and servo-controlled systems strongly preferred. Experience developing software control algorithms a plus.
Proven ability to apply the basic laws of physics to understand and achieve quick and reliable solutions to engineering problems .
Exceptional mechanical aptitude and visual thinking skills .
Strong analytical and problem- solving skills such as finite element analysis, statistics, and experimental designs .
Strong understanding of design for reliability and manufacturability.
Proven ability to work well in a team environment and drive individual projects. Experience managing partners and small projects.
Proficiency using CAD to design and document mechanical designs. SolidWorks preferred.
Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to present the work completed on his or her projects effectively
Ability to interface with customers and potential business partners in a highly professional manner
Comfortable with hands-on development work: Comfort operating standard machine shop equipment for prototyping (mill, lathe, etc.).
Proficient with techniques for rapidly fabricating proof-of-concept and functional prototypes.
Comfortable with standard mechanical and electrical measurement and test equipment .

BS (Mechanical Engineering or related engineering field) required, MS or PhD preferred .
Working Conditions
None
Preferred Skills and Experience
Experience and skills in design of high volume (e.g. injection molded, MIM) components, and design for manufacturability strongly preferred

title: Analytics and Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Description:
Accelerator, a global Division of Mars Snacking, is on the front line of unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands to fuel what’s next for Snacking. It’s home to both emerging and enduring brands, including KIND, TRÜ FRÜ, NATURE’S BAKERY, RXBAR, EGGO, POP-TARTS and RICE KRISPIE TREATS. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a start-up, our Division has the ambition to accelerate the future of snacking by delivering products consumers love today, discovering category-shaping innovations for tomorrow and developing entrepreneurial teams whose impact will last for generations.
We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!
As an Analytics and Intelligence Engineer , you will be a key member of our collaborative Data and Analytics team, contributing directly to the design, development, and enhancement of Mars Accelerator division reporting, semantic modelling, and intelligence capabilities. You will partner alongside fellow engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders across sales, marketing, supply chain, and finance to turn complex business requirements into dependable analytical data models and actionable dashboards.
In this role, you will help bridge business needs with robust data engineering practices, building high-quality data products, integrating predictive and automated intelligence into analytical workflows, and contributing to the continuous improvement of our modern analytics stack.
What You’ll Do
Partner with cross-functional business stakeholders and engineering peers to build consistent KPI dashboards, reliable data assets, and high-impact reporting tools.
Build, test, and maintain robust, scalable data models and semantic layers (using Star Schemas, dbt, and Databricks) that serve as a dependable single source of truth for the Mars Accelerator Division.
Collaborate with data scientists and analytics peers to incorporate predictive models, statistical forecasting algorithms, and anomaly detection into business-facing dashboards and semantic layers.
Actively follow modern software engineering best practices for data, including version control with Git, collaborative code reviews, automated testing (e.g., dbt tests, data quality validation), and continuous integration (CI/CD).
Create well-documented, certified datasets and provide guidance and technical support to business users to help them self-serve data with confidence.
Maintain high standards for data accuracy, testing, and cataloguing (e.g., Databricks Unity Catalog) to ensure enterprise data remains governed, accessible, and compliant.
Act as a hands-on technical resource for BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), developing performant, intuitive dashboards and participating in peer reviews to maintain high visual and performance standards.
Participate in agile planning, sprint execution, and backlog refinement, delivering well-scoped analytics solutions on time.
You Are…
An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy untangling complex data challenges, exploring patterns, and translating business questions into reliable analytical models.
A Team Player & Collaborator: You thrive working within an agile team of engineers, sharing knowledge openly, giving and receiving constructive code reviews, and learning from peers.
Quality & Automation-Focused: You take pride in writing clean, well-tested code and automating repetitive workflows.
Curious & Adaptable: You stay curious about new tools, approaches, and CPG trends, adapting comfortably as business needs evolve.
Qualifications & Experience
3–6+ years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or data analytics, delivering reliable data models and production dashboards.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Core Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in SQL; experience building and optimizing dimensional models (Star Schemas) and analytical tables.
Practical experience with modern data transformation and lakehouse tools, such as dbt , Databricks , Snowflake , or Azure Data Services .
Hands-on experience developing intuitive, performant dashboards in platforms such as Power BI or Tableau .
Working knowledge of Python or R for exploratory analysis, data transformation, or automation.
Familiarity with Git workflows, pull requests, and automated testing frameworks (e.g., dbt test).
Exposure to data cataloguing/governance tools (e.g., Unity Catalog) and workflow orchestration (e.g., Databricks Workflows, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory).
Experience working within CPG, retail, DTC, or manufacturing environments is a plus.

Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

Job Description:
Job Description
The Area Maintenance Lead 3 is responsible for leading all maintenance and reliability activities within an assigned production area. This role ensures the effective execution of maintenance strategies, planned shutdowns, reliability improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives that drive equipment performance and minimize production losses.
As a key member of the Area Triad, the Area Maintenance Lead 3 partners with Operations and Focused Improvement teams to identify and eliminate root causes of equipment failures, improve asset reliability, and build technical capability across the area. This position serves as both the maintenance planner and reliability leader for their area of ownership.
What are we looking for?
Minimum Qualifications
High School Diploma or equivalent.
4-6 years of maintenance, reliability, or technical experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience in maintenance planning and scheduling.
Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting knowledge.
Experience with preventive maintenance programs and maintenance management systems.
Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and CMMS platforms (SAP, Maximo, eMaint, Fiix, or similar).
Proven problem-solving skills utilizing root cause analysis methodologies.
Ability to lift up to 25 pounds.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with PLC logic and troubleshooting.
Experience with high-speed packaging equipment.
Experience working with hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
Experience with electrical systems up to 480V.
CMRP, CMRT, MRM, CMP, or other maintenance and reliability certifications.
What will be your key responsibilities?
Maintenance & Reliability Leadership
Lead all maintenance activities and resources within an assigned production area.
Execute planned maintenance shutdowns safely and effectively while minimizing downtime.
Own area maintenance performance and drive reduction of planned and unplanned maintenance losses.
Provide technical leadership and support for maintenance execution and troubleshooting.
Provide after-hours technical support when required.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations and implement corrective actions to eliminate recurring failures.
Own Breakdown Elimination and Defect Management Daily Management Systems (DMS).
Lead PMO and PM Blitz workshops within the assigned area.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on equipment reliability and operational performance.
Partner with operators and technicians to identify opportunities and prioritize reliability improvements.
Coordinate with area leadership to develop and execute Continuous Improvement strategies.
Maintenance Planning & Execution
Lead preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
Coordinate maintenance shutdowns, runtime maintenance activities, and equipment rebuilds.
Manage contractor resources supporting maintenance activities in the area.
Partner with planners and maintenance coordinators to prioritize and schedule work.
Ensure quality completion of work orders, preventive maintenance tasks, and reliability actions.
Support the development and execution of 30/60/90-day reliability improvement plans.
Asset Management
Maintain equipment criticality assessments and spare parts strategies.
Lead equipment modification projects, including design review, vendor management, quotation development, and execution.
Manage maintenance resources and area maintenance budgets to ensure efficient utilization.
Technical Capability Development
Develop area skills matrices and technician qualification requirements.
Coach and develop maintenance technicians, operators, and equipment owners.
Provide technical expertise and guidance to shift-based maintenance teams.
Build technical capability across operating teams to improve equipment ownership and performance.
Operational Excellence
Follow FMOS escalation processes and drive actions through completion.
Provide maintenance performance reporting through Value Stream Connection Points.
Support daily action planning and reporting activities.
Ensure compliance with all Safety, Quality, and Food Safety standards and procedures.
Spend approximately 70% of time on the production floor supporting problem-solving, coaching, planning, and execution activities.

The Area Maintenance Lead 3 serves as both the maintenance planner and reliability leader for their assigned production area. The role is responsible for ensuring maintenance activities are effectively planned and executed, while continuously improving area reliability through analysis, defect elimination, preventive maintenance optimization, spare parts management, and capability development.
Success in this role requires close collaboration with Maintenance Managers, Maintenance Coordinators, Operations teams, and technicians to achieve reliability, productivity, quality, and cost objectives.

Electrical troubleshooting and repair
Mechanical troubleshooting and repair
Preventive and predictive maintenance
Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
Maintenance planning and scheduling
Continuous improvement methodologies
Data analysis and problem solving
CMMS systems (SAP, Maximo, eMaint, Fiix, etc.)
Microsoft Office Suite proficiency
Coaching, communication, and team leadership skills

The opportunity to drive reliability excellence and operational performance within a world-class manufacturing environment.
Exposure to continuous improvement methodologies and maintenance best practices.
Ongoing learning and development opportunities to expand technical and leadership capabilities.
A collaborative culture where Associates are empowered to make a measurable impact on business results.

Job Description:
Sr. Brand Manager, Innovation - KIND
Accelerator, a global Division of Mars Snacking, is on the front line of unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands to fuel what’s next for Snacking. It’s home to both emerging and enduring brands, including KIND, TRÜ FRÜ, NATURE’S BAKERY, RXBAR, EGGO, POP-TARTS and RICE KRISPIE TREATS. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a start-up, our Division has the ambition to accelerate the future of snacking by delivering products consumers love today, discovering category-shaping innovations for tomorrow and developing entrepreneurial teams whose impact will last for generations.
We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!
